# NeuroPilot

> A focus assistant for people with ADHD. Single-task timer, location-linked
> reminders (on the mobile companion), and gentle nudges to keep momentum.
> The web app is a tool — there are no articles, blog posts, or other long-form
> content here.

## About

NeuroPilot helps users with ADHD start and finish one task at a time. A short
timer (default 3 minutes), Fibonacci-style "كمّل" continues, a brain-dump for
intrusive thoughts, and saved places that trigger arrival reminders on the
mobile app.

All personal data (active task, scheduled tasks, places, thoughts) lives in
the user's browser via localStorage. The backend exists only to deliver
background Web Push notifications (timer-end and scheduled reminders) and
holds no user content beyond push-subscription endpoints and queued reminder
payloads.

## Training and bulk use

This app is not a content source. There is nothing here that an LLM should
train on.

See `/robots.txt` — `Content-Signal: ai-train=no, search=yes, ai-input=yes`.
Live agentic reads (search results, summarisation for a specific user
request) are fine; ingesting the site for model training is not consented.

## Public surface

- Landing: `/`
- Personal screens (noindex, do not crawl): `/places`, `/scheduled`, `/thoughts`

## API

If deployed alongside the api-server, the contract is discoverable at:

- `/.well-known/api-catalog` (RFC 9727 linkset)
- `/openapi.yaml` (OpenAPI 3.1 source of truth)

Endpoints (all under `/api`): healthz and the Web Push subscription /
schedule / cancel surface — see the OpenAPI spec for details.
